user.title: Room thermostat
user.description: Choose the devices for one room. Control devices starts off so you can review decisions before operating hardware. All selected actuators will be managed together. Room presence: every sensor must be off to start absence timers; unknown keeps comfort. Coming home bypasses empty-room pauses, while windows and outdoor limits still apply.

data.name: Room name
data.outdoor_policy: Outdoor limits: inherit global / custom room / disabled
data.outdoor_sensor: Outdoor sensor (room: leave empty to use global sensor)
data.pause_heat_when_empty: Pause heating when room is empty
data.pause_cool_when_empty: Pause AC cooling when room is empty
data.cool_absence_minutes: No presence before pausing AC cooling (minutes)

error.room_required: Enter a room name and select at least one radiator.
error.duplicate_device: Select each device only once; the AC cannot also be a radiator.
error.nested_room: Select physical device entities, not another Room Comfort thermostat.
error.unsupported_device: Radiators require Heat, Off and a single target temperature. The AC also requires Cool.
error.already_assigned: A selected device is already controlled by another Room Comfort room.
error.invalid_sensor: Select a temperature sensor with Celsius or Fahrenheit units.
error.cooling_requires_ac: Assign an air conditioner to use cooling for Coming home.
error.outdoor_sensor_required: Choose an outdoor temperature sensor; room overrides can use the global sensor.
error.outdoor_limits_overlap: Heating and cooling limits, including hysteresis, must not overlap.
